questions.question: What does Ecclesiastes 12 urge the young to do?
options: Honor your father and mother all of your days
Seek wisdom before pleasure while you are strong
Number your days, that you may gain a heart of wisdom
Remember your Creator in the days of your youth
questions.answer: Remember your Creator in the days of your youth

questions.question: What is the conclusion of the whole matter in Ecclesiastes?
options: Eat, drink, and enjoy your toil, for this is your portion in life
Love the LORD your God with all your heart and soul
Get wisdom, and with all your getting, get understanding
Fear God and keep his commandments, for this is the whole duty of man
questions.answer: Fear God and keep his commandments, for this is the whole duty of man
